patterns.why_seen: Observed recovery-to-gross ratio is below the Financial-event baseline.

issue_details: A time-sensitive client notification was not generated after a workflow status changed. The service team identified the missing message during a follow-up review.
root_cause_details: The simulated review attributed the event to technology / system defect. The control environment did not detect or prevent the issue at the earliest possible point.
The simulated review attributed the event to data quality / mapping error. The control environment did not detect or prevent the issue at the earliest possible point.
The simulated review attributed the event to third-party dependency. The control environment did not detect or prevent the issue at the earliest possible point.
opportunities: Add completeness monitoring for notifications and route failures to an owned queue.
